faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Research Associate - III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Madras Research Associate - III position is 27 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate - III at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate - III post at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. This recruitment drive aims to fill a single position for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Madras Research Associate - III Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Madras Research Associate - III Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate - III position at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate - III post will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, along with an additional 30% HRA. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Madras Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the IIT Madras Research Associate - III Recruitment 2026 is online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D./MS or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Optics, Photonics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field. Alternatively, 3 years of research/teaching/design experience after ME/MTech with at least one SCI paper is required.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Research Associate - III be posted?
faq.answer: The selected Research Associate - III will be posted in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, which is the location of the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. This position offers an opportunity to work in a premier institute.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Madras Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test or interview, and finally document verification. Candidates must clear all stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Specific age limits for the Research Associate - III position are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF for detailed information regarding age criteria and relaxations.
